- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Arrowhead Springs Hotel and Spa was a popular destination in the 1930s and 40s, hosting celebrities like Marilyn Monroe and Frank Sinatra; it is now a conference center and retreat.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] San Bernardino is part of Route 66, with landmarks including the original McDonald's, which opened in 1940.
